description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build product interfaces, backend systems, and internal tools for a reinforcement learning data platform. You will own end-to-end experiences that help research teams and external partners create, evaluate, and improve training data.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop tools for browsing environments, inspecting trajectories, reviewing task quality, and understanding model behavior.

 - Build partner workflows for creating, submitting, testing, and iterating on reinforcement learning environments and training data.

 - Create dashboards and observability tools for environment quality, evaluation results, data collection progress, and pipeline health.

 - Design backend services and APIs that connect task authoring, data collection, evaluation, quality assurance, and training infrastructure.

 - Work with research, operations, and go-to-market teams to ship useful systems quickly, even when requirements are evolving.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of full-stack engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

 - Strong Python skills and experience with React, TypeScript, Next.js, or a comparable modern web stack.

 - Experience owning user-facing or internal products end-to-end, from design through deployment.

 - Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging.

 - Experience building dashboards, monitoring or debugging tools, data collection or evaluation platforms, and partner-facing workflows.

 - Knowledge of backend services, APIs, and databases that connect multiple system components.

 - Strong product judgment and communication skills, with the ability to build intuitive tools for technical and non-technical users.

 - A technical background or shipped work that demonstrates mid-to-senior engineering depth.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for full-time candidates relocating to the United States or Singapore.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco or Singapore, with remote candidates considered if they can maintain 70% to 80% time zone overlap with either location.
